bounded_residency.instructions: Does the new code keep at most a small fixed number (≤2) of decoded background images and free older ones?

criteria.true: Residency is bounded and old ones are freed.
criteria.false: Backgrounds can accumulate or residency is not bounded.

callers_unchanged_or_justified.instructions: Are background callers (createdgui.cpp, backgroundSelector.js, loadingscreen.cpp, gamemenue.cpp) either unchanged or changed only under HANDHELD_BUILD with a clear reason?

criteria.true: Callers are unchanged or changes are guarded and justified.
criteria.false: Callers changed for desktop or without reason.

menu_ram_drop.instructions: Does menu_rss_mb in the 1A-04 receipt drop by at least 150 MB compared with the 1A-03-ram entry in state.ram_history_all_cards?
